# SYGMA TV+

> SYGMA TV+ ("One World. Endless Entertainment.") is a streaming subscription for live TV, movies and series on Smart TVs, mobile devices and computers. It is a brand of Sygma TV LLC, a company established in 2026 and registered in the State of New Mexico, United States. Online orders and free trials are not open yet: the website presents the plans and explains how ordering, free trials and refunds will work once they open.

## Status

- Online orders and free trials are not open yet. They cannot be arranged by email, WhatsApp or any other channel yet.
- The plan simulator on the home page already shows the plans, durations and prices (in USD).

## Service

- Plans are yearly: 12, 24 or 36 months.
- Every plan includes 1 device; devices can be added, up to 4.
- Supported devices: Smart TVs, streaming boxes and sticks, smartphones, tablets and computers.
- The website is available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish and Norwegian Bokmål.

## Company

- Legal name: Sygma TV LLC (brand: SYGMA TV+)
- Established: 2026, State of New Mexico, United States
- Registered address: 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE, Ste H, Albuquerque, NM 87110, United States
- Email: support@sygmatv.com
